appDescription: A family car profile app that applies each driver's seat, climate and screen theme settings to the shared car.

function.name: APPLY_NEXT_DRIVER
function.description: Apply the profile of the family member who reserved this car as the next driver, including seat, climate and screen theme.

function.name: APPLY_DRIVER_PROFILE
function.description: Apply a specific family member's saved driving profile to this car, including seat, climate and screen theme.

driverName.description: Name or nickname of the family member who will drive.

profileName.description: Name of one of that family member's saved profiles.

function.name: SHOW_DRIVER_PROFILES
function.description: Show the list of family members and their saved driving profiles on the car screen so the driver can choose one.
